mutations.change: The tier 3 copy writes & for && and the or operator that does not short-circuit for the one that does, so the right operand runs when the left one decides the result.
mutations.find: return left.Text + " " + binary.OperatorToken.Text + " " + Visit(binary.Right, rightGuard, capture: true).Text;
mutations.replace: return left.Text + (binary.IsKind(SyntaxKind.LogicalOrExpression) ? " | " : " & ") + Visit(binary.Right, rightGuard, capture: true).Text;

mutations.change: Returns and Throws leave the mock call they configure in the received calls.
A call takes the first matching response instead of the last.
A Received or DidNotReceive check also runs the matching response, so a Returns sequence advances and a Returns factory runs.
The runner does not dispose a test's own container.
The runner does not end a test's VerifyScope, so the test's Check failures are dropped.
